span.raw:
Under the Orion Purchase Agreement, Wheaton agreed to acquire the existing gold and
silver purchase agreement between Orion and BMC Minerals Ltd. (“BMC Minerals”) (the “KZK PMPA”) in respect of gold and silver production from the Kudz Ze Kayah project located in central Yukon, Canada (the “Kudz Ze
Kayah project” or the “KZK project”). On closing of the Orion Purchase Agreement on February 27, 2024, Wheaton and Wheaton International paid an aggregate of $450 million to Orion for all three existing streams.
